svg.desc: Six project cards in two groups. Security and Cloud: Secure-by-Design Trainer (interactive security training), Cloud and AI Security Study (exam-prep dashboard and drills), Structure Vision (construction photo classifier). Creative and AI tooling: Video Explainer Engine (AI-voiced collage reels), Puzzle Game (browser geometry puzzle), Portfolio Lab (UI prototypes).
